SELECT Payments.Ref AS Ref, Payments.Date AS Date, Payments.CashRegister AS CashRegister, Payments.Company AS Company, Payments.Hotel AS Hotel, Payments.Sum AS Sum, Payments.VATRate AS VATRate, Payments.VATSum AS VATSum, Payments.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, Payments.Payer AS Payer, Payments.Folio AS Folio, Payments.ExternalCode AS ExternalCode, Payments.ParentDoc AS ParentDoc, NULL AS Status, Payments.Author AS Author, Payments.AccountingDate AS AccountingDate, Payments.PaymentMethod AS PaymentMethod, TRUE AS IsPayment, FALSE AS IsReturn, FALSE AS IsPreauthorisation, FALSE AS IsCustomerPayment, Payments.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, "" AS Type, Payments.Number AS Number, Payments.AccountingCustomer AS AccountingCustomer, Payments.Posted AS Posted FROM Document.Payment AS Payments WHERE (Payments.Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel) OR &qHotel = VALUE(Catalog.Hotels.EmptyRef)) AND CASE WHEN &qDateListMode = 0 THEN Payments.Date BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo ELSE Payments.AccountingDate BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo END
UNION ALL
SELECT Return.Ref, Return.Date, Return.CashRegister, Return.Company, Return.Hotel, Return.Sum, Return.VATRate, Return.VATSum, Return.GuestGroup, Return.Payer, Return.Folio, Return.ExternalCode, Return.ParentDoc, NULL, Return.Author, Return.AccountingDate, Return.PaymentMethod, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, Return.DeletionMark, "", Return.Number, Return.AccountingCustomer, Return.Posted FROM Document.Return AS Return WHERE (Return.Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel) OR &qHotel = VALUE(Catalog.Hotels.EmptyRef)) AND CASE WHEN &qDateListMode = 0 THEN Return.Date BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo ELSE Return.AccountingDate BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo END
UNION ALL
SELECT Preauthorisation.Ref, Preauthorisation.Date, Preauthorisation.CashRegister, Preauthorisation.Company, Preauthorisation.Hotel, Preauthorisation.Sum, NULL, NULL, Preauthorisation.GuestGroup, Preauthorisation.Payer, Preauthorisation.Folio, Preauthorisation.ExternalCode, Preauthorisation.ParentDoc, Preauthorisation.Status, Preauthorisation.Author, Preauthorisation.AccountingDate, Preauthorisation.PaymentMethod, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, Preauthorisation.DeletionMark, "", Preauthorisation.Number, NULL, Preauthorisation.Posted FROM Document.Preauthorisation AS Preauthorisation WHERE (Preauthorisation.Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel) OR &qHotel = VALUE(Catalog.Hotels.EmptyRef)) AND CASE WHEN &qDateListMode = 0 THEN Preauthorisation.Date BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo ELSE Preauthorisation.AccountingDate BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo END
UNION ALL
SELECT CustomerPayments.Ref, CustomerPayments.Date, CustomerPayments.CashRegister, CustomerPayments.Company, CustomerPayments.Hotel, CustomerPayments.Sum, NULL, NULL, CustomerPayments.GuestGroup, NULL, NULL, CustomerPayments.ExternalCode, CustomerPayments.ParentDoc, NULL, CustomerPayments.Author, CustomerPayments.AccountingDate, CustomerPayments.PaymentMethod, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, CustomerPayments.DeletionMark, "", CustomerPayments.Number, CustomerPayments.AccountingCustomer, CustomerPayments.Posted FROM Document.CustomerPayment AS CustomerPayments WHERE (CustomerPayments.Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel) OR &qHotel = VALUE(Catalog.Hotels.EmptyRef)) AND CASE WHEN &qDateListMode = 0 THEN CustomerPayments.Date BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo ELSE CustomerPayments.AccountingDate BETWEEN &qDateFrom AND &qDateTo END AND CustomerPayments.PaymentMethod.BookByCashRegister
